payload.reason: The evidence provides information about the experimental results related to a new dataset for fine-grained sentiment analysis, indicating that preliminary results were reported.

claims.text: The preliminary experimental results indicate the effectiveness of the new dataset for fine-grained sentiment analysis.
The first experimental results on the dataset serve as benchmarks for further experiments in neural machine learning of fine-grained opinions.
The dataset includes annotations for polar expressions, targets, and holders of opinion, which were evaluated in the experiments.
